site_name: Smiths FarmKensington RoadNortholtMiddlesexUB5 6AH
description: Construction of 5 residential buildings (3-5 storeys in height) to provide a range of houses and flats (total of 189 residential units); conversion of existing farmhouse and barns to provide a cafe / commercial unit (Class E); and Improved Public Access between Northala Fields & Marnham Fields with associated enhanced landscaping (Masterplan for wider Green Belt and Public Open Space), parking and refuse storage.
